name: tau2-retail-order-choice-replay-01
assignment: Every eligible historical target/source and both repeats get a separate fresh instance of each of five arms. Randomize all 140 slots by salted hash independent of outcomes. Preserve original solver route, seed, reasoning, output limit, tools and public prefix. All four authentic original notes for one source form a single read-only bank in the registered form order; keep voluntary empty writes. Use a matching empty control for each enabled interface. The unchanged pure baseline gets no memory notice, snapshot or extra tools.
endpoint: Stop at the first response with a business call or a customer reply. For query arms dispatch memory-only rounds privately and include the recorded returns in the next request, up to four worker responses. A mixed business/memory batch is a terminal proposed decision; execute no business or mixed tools. Record calls, returned titles and bodies, actual input spans, round-limit failures, and every provider receipt. No customer simulator, order mutation or official grading.
primary: Paired difference between preload and empty_preload in exactly one get_order_details call for the order identified in the current public request. Include all registered source banks. Average available paired repeat differences within source/target, then target, then customer with equal customer weights; report paired counts, missingness and a descriptive customer bootstrap interval.
secondary: Compare query with empty_query, each memory arm with no_memory, and preload with query. Report included-target-with-additional-calls, other order, customer reply, memory uptake and cost. All 14 pairs share 11 states in seven previously studied customers; keep generalization and any later free consultation separate.
billing: User authorized a new USD 0.50 ceiling for 140 decisions only. Send sequentially. Before every send reserve the full wire's verified upper cost under frozen rates against confirmed plus unresolved charges. Keep that maximum for a request whose charge is not known. Never repeat an attempted slot. Respect routing cooldowns before untouched slots; stop on an unreconciled ledger, provider/model mismatch or exhausted limits.
